What if you wore super tight jeans every day?
Skinny jeans were one of the biggest fashion trends of the twenty tens. They look sharp. Lots of people wear them all day without a problem.

But here's the twist. Doctors reported a woman who squatted for hours in skinny jeans until her legs went numb and weak, because the pressure squeezed her muscles and nerves! They called it skinny jeans syndrome. Doctors say if your legs tingle or go numb, it's time to loosen up! Super tight waistbands can also squeeze your stomach and make heartburn worse.
